name: Glenstone (dressed)
notes: The valley's pale, honey-grey freestone (story bible §3.1), which cuts clean and carves fine: Priory walls, the Wendmouth quays, the Deepworks' old galleries, cut blocks. A freestone is a fine-grained limestone or sandstone, so it is lighter (2300 kg/m³) and a little softer (300 hp) than rough stone. Dressed faces are smooth, so climbing them needs skill or a tool (grade 3) and they are slightly less grippy (0.55). Rough, uncut glenstone rock can use the stone preset.
